definition: A reusable, parameterized structure for constructing prompts, with placeholders filled in with task-specific content at runtime.
details: Prompt templates help standardize and version prompt logic in production AI applications, making it easier to test, compare, and maintain consistent prompting behavior across a system.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. In plain words: A reusable, parameterized structure for constructing prompts, with placeholders filled in with task-specific content at runtime. Here is how it actually plays out: Prompt templates help standardize and version prompt logic in production AI applications, making it easier to test, compare, and maintain consistent prompting behavior across a system. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Prompt Template.
